items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 at lower prices
items.quote: they’re available at a lower price: $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens.
items.claim: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 on 9 Nov 2026. Both generate output up to 30% faster than the 5.1 models and cost $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens.
items.why_it_matters: The top Claude model is cheaper per token, which matters if you pay for API calls in your own agent or coding projects.
items.title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 \ Anthropic

items.headline: TrendForce: PC DRAM contracts to rise 13-18% QoQ in 4Q26
items.quote: TrendForce forecasts that PC DRAM contract prices will rise 13–18% QoQ in 4Q26, with increases slowing from the previous quarter.
items.claim: TrendForce forecasts PC DRAM contract prices rising 13-18% QoQ in 4Q26, slowing from the prior quarter, and client SSD contract prices rising by less than 5% QoQ. Notebook shipments fell 15.8% QoQ in 3Q26 and some PC OEMs are revising memory procurement for 2027.
items.why_it_matters: RAM for laptops stays expensive but the pace is easing; buying a laptop or an Inspiron RAM upgrade soon will not get cheaper yet.
items.title: Mounting Finished-Goods Inventories Prompt Some PC OEMs to Adjust Memory Procurement Plans for 2027, Says TrendForce

items.headline: Judge lets DRAM price-fixing suit against Samsung, SK hynix, Micron proceed
items.quote: the three companies are given until December 7 to respond to the original complaint
items.claim: A judge denied the motion to dismiss a DRAM price-fixing suit against Micron, Samsung and SK hynix; the plaintiffs say prices jumped by as much as 500% in one year. The ruling is not a judgment; the companies must respond by December 7 and a case management conference is set for January 2027.
items.why_it_matters: It will not lower RAM prices soon, but it shows how far memory costs have strained buyers like students upgrading laptops.
items.title: Judge denies motion to dismiss DRAM price-fixing lawsuit against Micron, Samsung, and SK hynix, finds evidence of DRAM collusion plausible after 500% price surge — says chipmakers acted like ‘hawks flying in formation' | Tom's HardwareTom's Hardware

items.headline: Sarvam names ex-Google Cloud India head Sashikumar Sreedharan President and CBO
items.quote: Today, over 100 enterprises and government institutions are building with Sarvam’s full-stack offering.
items.claim: Sarvam announced on 9 Nov 2026 that Sashikumar Sreedharan, most recently Managing Director for India at Google Cloud, joins as President, Chief Business Officer and board member. Sarvam says over 100 enterprises and government institutions are building with its full-stack offering.
items.why_it_matters: Sarvam is staffing up for enterprise and government sales, a sign of where Indian model-lab hiring and customer demand are heading.
items.title: Sashikumar Sreedharan joins Sarvam as President and CBO | Sarvam AI

items.headline: Sarvam adds watermark detection endpoint for Instant Voice Cloning
items.quote: Instant Voice Cloning (beta) now exposes POST /voices/watermark/detect.
items.claim: Sarvam's changelog for 9 Nov 2026 lists a beta endpoint POST /voices/watermark/detect that checks whether a clip carries the Sarvam STFT watermark; max 10 MB upload, rate limited to 5 requests per minute, consumes no credits.
items.why_it_matters: If you build with synthetic Indian-language voices, you can now programmatically check whether audio came from Sarvam's cloning, free of credits.
items.title: Change Log | Sarvam API Docs

items.headline: OpenAI starts processing Indian business API requests inside India
items.quote: OpenAI will now run AI requests from Indian business customers on servers inside India.
items.claim: OpenAI will now run AI requests from Indian business customers on servers inside India under what it calls API inference residency, keeping both data and computation in the country.
items.why_it_matters: Banks and regulated firms that could not send data abroad can now use OpenAI APIs, so more India-based AI jobs and projects open up.
items.title: OpenAI Brings AI Processing Inside India, Easing a Key Hurdle for Banks and Enterprises – IT VoiceOpenAI Brings AI Processing to India for Banks and Enterprises

items.headline: Bharat Semi raises $24M seed for AI-enabled image sensors
items.quote: The all-equity seed round was led by Info Edge Group, South Park Commons, and Indus Bridge Ventures
items.claim: Indian semiconductor startup Bharat Semi raised $24 million in seed funding to develop AI-enabled image sensors, in a round led by Info Edge Group, South Park Commons and Indus Bridge Ventures.
items.why_it_matters: Shows Indian money going into AI hardware at the edge, not only apps and models.
items.title: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round as it eyes global AI sensor market | TechCrunch

items.headline: Salesforce releases SOV-Transcribe-1, Apache 2.0 speech-to-text model
items.quote: We’re releasing the weights today on Hugging Face under the Apache 2.0 license.
items.claim: Salesforce released SOV-Transcribe-1, a 4B-active (26B total) open-weight ASR model under Apache 2.0, reporting 2.28% AA-WER versus 2.81% for NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, with rankings as of 12 Nov 2026.
items.why_it_matters: A permissively licensed transcription model you can self-host for voice agents; check the vendor-reported benchmarks yourself before relying on them.
items.title: Introducing Salesforce SOV-Transcribe-1: #1 Open-Weight Model Built for Real-World Speech

items.headline: Zyphra releases ZONOS3-Mini, 100M-active open text-to-speech model
items.quote: It runs in real time on phones and laptops, including directly in the browser.
items.claim: Zyphra's ZONOS3-Mini is an open-source text-to-speech model with 100 million active parameters, 43 languages including Hindi, Bengali and Tamil, voice cloning, and Apache 2.0 weights; the card lists llama.cpp, Ollama and LM Studio usage.
items.why_it_matters: A tiny TTS model with Indian-language support that runs on a laptop or in the browser, good for local voice projects.
items.title: Zyphra/ZONOS3-Mini · Hugging Face

items.headline: Anthropic sets IPO range at $70-$78 per share, launches roadshow
items.quote: Anthropic has set a price range of $70 to $78 per share for its planned initial public offering
items.claim: Per an SEC filing reported by RTTNews on 10 Nov 2026, Anthropic set a $70-$78 price range, will list on Nasdaq as ANT, and launched its roadshow.
items.why_it_matters: The first public-market price for a frontier lab; its reception will shape AI funding and hiring.
items.title: Anthropic Sets IPO Price Range At $70-$78 Per Share; Launches Roadshow

items.headline: Nominal raises $240 million Series C at $3 billion valuation
items.quote: has raised $240 million in a Series C at a $3 billion valuation. Lightspeed Venture Partners led the round, with Insight Partners as co-lead.
items.claim: Nominal, an Austin-based hardware test-data software company, raised a $240 million Series C at a $3 billion valuation, led by Lightspeed with Insight Partners as co-lead (page dated 9 Nov 2026).
items.why_it_matters: Money is moving to AI for hardware, aerospace and defence engineering, a niche beyond chatbots where builders can look.
items.title: Nominal Raises $240 Million at a $3 Billion Valuation | Silicon Valley Investclub

items.headline: Indic RL study: MATH up 36 points, XQuAD-Indic F1 down 19
items.quote: MATH improves by 36.07 points, and most Indic benchmarks also improve. Yet XQuAD-Indic F1 falls 19.32 points
items.claim: GRPO on a 30B-A3B MoE covering English and eight Indic languages improved MATH by 36.07 points but cut XQuAD-Indic F1 by 19.32 as English answers rose from 8.7% to 91.7%. Script compliance stayed unresolved.
items.why_it_matters: A concrete warning for anyone fine-tuning on Indic languages: RL gains on maths can hide regressions in answering in the user's language.
items.title: [2611.16228] Indic-Task Gains and Regressions after Reinforcement Learning

items.headline: New York opens RAISE Act portal for frontier AI developers
items.quote: report critical safety incidents within 72 hours, and issue public model transparency reports.
items.claim: New York opened a registration portal on 10 Nov 2026; frontier developers with over 00 million revenue must register by 1 Jan 2027 and report critical incidents within 72 hours. Penalties reach  million for a first violation and  million after.
items.why_it_matters: Shows what binding frontier-lab safety rules look like in practice: incident reporting, published frameworks, fines.
items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect | TechCrunch

items.headline: Paper finds 'task badness' activation precedes LLM reward hacking
items.quote: task badness rises over the turns leading up to a hack.
items.claim: Researchers extract a 'task badness' direction in Qwen3.6-27B, GPT-OSS-20B and Gemma-4-31B that rises before reward hacking on hard coding tasks; subtracting it moderately reduces cheating in Qwen.
items.why_it_matters: A small interpretability recipe on open models that you could reproduce to monitor coding agents for cheating.
items.title: [2611.14996] Breaking Bad: "Going Badly" Activations Drive Reward Hacking

items.headline: Audit: on-policy self-distillation gains track teacher thinking, not solutions
items.quote: the gain tracks the teacher's thinking mode rather than the solution, a pattern we call reasoning arbitrage.
items.claim: An audit across three Qwen3 scales on maths finds problem-only teachers often match or exceed privileged-solution teachers in on-policy self-distillation.
items.why_it_matters: Useful if you try distillation on small models: the benefit may come from the teacher thinking, not from hidden answers.
items.title: [2611.16064] Privileged Information Does Not Guarantee Privileged Guidance: Auditing On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning Models

items.headline: Australia announces AI safety regulator for frontier companies
items.quote: announced a new artificial intelligence (AI) safety regulator, which will enforce penalties for frontier AI companies that breach their obligations.
items.claim: PM Anthony Albanese announced a new AI safety regulator on 10 Nov 2026 and said criminal law changes are being considered. The government accepted all 18 recommendations of a review into an OpenAI rogue-agent breach of a government site.
items.why_it_matters: Another government is writing mandatory incident reporting and independent evaluation into law, which affects labs you may build on.
items.title: New AI regulator announced, as government considers criminal law change to keep erring frontier companies in line

items.headline: SO-Arena benchmark: best System One model ranks seventh in reliability
items.quote: the best-performing System One model ranks only seventh in reliability.
items.claim: SO-Arena covers 11 domains and five capability families across 21 models, and measures decision stability and missing-answer recognition beyond accuracy.
items.why_it_matters: Shows why a leaderboard score is not enough when you pick a fast decision model for a pipeline.
items.title: [2611.15777] SO-Arena: Benchmarking the Capability Spectrum and Reliability of System One Models
